title: Overcast, G running local
liner_notes: Low clouds over Greenpoint and the G is crawling northbound again, so we're keeping it slow and warm this morning: dub, ambient, a few rainy-day soul cuts. Energy creeps up after sunset at 5:52, because the tide's in and so are we.
Only four bikes left at the Nassau dock means the neighborhood already went out without us. So we dug deeper than usual.
